reviewer: Codex: authored five-language course and actual synthetic native output review
review_scope: Reviewed all five complete authored narratives and the actual DOCX structure, profiles and financial analysis from ten independent native demo/practice regressions. Regression approvals are expressly simulated, never learner decisions. Structural artifact inspection does not establish visual pagination, font availability on a learner host, installed enabled-plugin execution, native voice, paired-window or learner acceptance. Tests run local component code without model or network calls. No jurisdiction qualification is claimed.

editorial.purpose_and_first_use: The first use turns explicitly selected fictional Word evidence into a reviewed private format, then reuses it in the current financial report builder. Scope explicitly excludes model training, exact template cloning and unsupported document generators.
editorial.inputs_and_request: The language-specific raw JSON supplies a fictional Word example and independent accounting CSV generated locally. The natural request asks for observations, missing-setting proposals, two previews and adoption of the exact user-approved version; no client material is required.
editorial.execution_and_checkpoints: The installed specialist owns the current workflow. Observations and proposals remain distinct. Both short and long previews must be opened and explicitly accepted before adoption. Tests independently choose complete fixture settings and simulate that decision; they do not attest learner review or model-led interpretation.
editorial.deliverable_and_next_action: Formatting evidence, two real DOCX previews, private versioned profile and a ledger-backed financial report are inspectable outputs. The lesson requires all-page visual review and separate normal review of figures and conclusions. Actual synthetic report numeric analysis remains unchanged after formatting revision.
editorial.practice_and_repeat: Fresh Studio Selva practice uses a separate workspace, Times New Roman and different source amounts. Revision creates profile version two and preserves version one and email settings. Repeat specifies the authorized private workspace and selected examples, then an explicitly selected supported financial report.
editorial.language_and_pacing: The complete it narrative preserves the same checkpoints, privacy/configuration boundaries and independent practice. Generated headers and footers match that selected language. The nominal 390 seconds are instruction pacing; no measured learner duration or completed learner exercise is claimed.

demo.result_review: Inspected actual short/long DOCX structures and localized headers/footers for Studio Riva, using Arial. Approval without confirmation is rejected and creates no adopted profile. Explicitly simulated review creates version one; revision changes paragraph spacing to 12 points and archives the exact earlier profile while preserving email settings. The real ledger-backed report uses the selected studio identity and font. Its amount sum is 14500; complete report_analysis.json is identical before and after revision, and the earlier report retains its earlier format settings. These are component regression results, not learner or installed-host acceptance.
